replacements.reason: Match ftCo_Dash_IASA at GALE01 0x800CA508 through 0x800CA51C: retain the separately rounded gr_vel*x54 fmuls, then express the original negation and fmadds with one binary32 rounding. The complete Yoshi/Falcon frame-4826 witness uses gr_vel 0x3f8b8522, x54 0x3f400000, and friction 0x3fc00000, yielding 0xbe0b8522 fused instead of 0xbe0b8520 unfused. Use Slippi binary64 intermediate rounding before binary32 storage; direct host fmaf differs at double-rounding boundaries.
